sentences.en: So about 10 days into this military campaign, the Israeli and American militaries have struck more than 4,000 targets over this time period.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这场军事行动大约10天后，以色列和美国军队在这期间已经打击了4,000多个目标。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So this includes, obviously, the first day strike that killed the supreme leader, the main political goal, I think, of Israel and to some extent the United States.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这包括第一天击毙最高领袖的空袭，我认为这是以色列、并在某种程度上也是美国的主要政治目标。

sentences.en: But from a military standpoint, of these 4,000 targets, they've really focused heavily on eliminating Iran's air defenses.
sentences.zh: 但从军事角度来看，在这4,000个目标中，他们实际上把很大一部分精力放在了消灭伊朗的防空系统上。

sentences.en: These are the surface-to-air missiles that could attack American bombers, Israeli jets, those kind of things.
sentences.zh: 这些是能够攻击美国轰炸机、以色列战机等地对空导弹。

sentences.en: So they've gone after that to give the Israeli and American air forces freedom of movement in the skies.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在打击这些目标，以便为以色列和美国空军在天空中争取到行动自由。

sentences.en: The other big targets include the ballistic missiles, which actually go up into space and come back down again.
sentences.zh: 另一个重大目标包括弹道导弹，它们实际上会飞入太空然后再度返回。

sentences.en: and they arc back down against their long-range, very fast-moving targets that cause a lot of damage.
sentences.zh: 它们呈弧线坠落，针对的是射程远、速度极快且会造成巨大破坏的目标。

sentences.en: The other main focus has been to strike the Iranian Navy.

sentences.en: And then lastly, the United States has tried to go after Iran's formidable drone program.
sentences.zh: 最后，美国一直试图打击伊朗庞大的无人机项目。

sentences.en: These are the same drones that Iran has manufactured and have been used by the Russians in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这些就是伊朗制造的、并已被俄罗斯在乌克兰使用的同款无人机。

sentences.en: These are formidable because as much as the United States has air defenses against these

sentences.en: and a wide array of things from jamming to small weapons to actually counter drone drones, if you will,
